title: spec: the override declaration, the `.custom` pairing constants, the `<base_ns>_custom` namespace rule, the `__c` reservation, the overridable-type list and the base-field display whitelist
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P1, cut after ADR-0146's rewrite merged in #28295) · the shared definitions N-09, N-10, N-13, N-14 and N-23a/b read. ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #28236 (P1, child **N-08**) · governs: ADR-0146 D2 (declaration, type list), D3 (pairing, namespace, range), D6 (excluded types), D10 (`__c`, display whitelist) · lane: `domain:spec` · size: M.

**Follows #28390 ruling A** (6542177429): only the paired `<base>.custom` declares an override. The pair predicate below is what the gates read.

**Business reason.** A developer writing `hotcrm.custom` in a repository and an administrator customizing in Studio must produce the same declaration, one the write gate, the read, export and `os validate` all understand. Without one Zod shape and one set of constants, every door would spell "this item overrides HotCRM's" its own way.

**Measured (`75ecaf4ad8`).**
- `packages/spec/src` has no `overrides` key, `.custom` constant or `__c` rule; no `__c` name appears in non-test sources under `examples/` or `packages/`.
- Every type D2 lists spreads `MetadataProtectionFields` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-protection.zod.ts:81`).
- `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`) has 30 entries. Four runtime-creatable types appear on neither side of D2: `seed`, `external_catalog`, `tool`, `skill`.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts:54#deriveNamespaceFromPackageId` returns `custom` for `hotcrm.custom`. Namespaces must match `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}$/` (`namespace-prefix.ts:18#NAMESPACE_RE`; the same regex inline at `manifest.zod.ts:564`), so `<base_ns>_custom` fits only a base namespace of 13 characters or fewer. The longest in the repository is `feature_flags` at 13 (`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/feature-flags.manifest.ts:7`).
- Field names match `/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1363`), which admits `region__c`. `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:4709#ObjectExtensionSchema` is strict and has no slot for patching a single field.

**Wanted.**
1. An optional `overrides: { package, basedOn }` on every overridable type, one shared field set in the style of `MetadataProtectionFields`; its `.describe()` says `basedOn` is recorded and never judged (D2). The key survives `defineStack()`, the stored body and export.
2. Pairing constants and pure helpers: the `.custom` suffix, `customizationPackageId(baseId)`, `isCustomizationPackage(id)`, the base of a pair, an "is the pair of" predicate, and the dependency range `^<major>` from the base's `manifest.version` (D3; merge item 1). Dotted ids such as `com.example.showcase.custom` are covered. **N-08 owns these; N-13 (the ensure door) and N-14 (uninstall protection) consume them and are `Blocked-by` this card.** ⛔ Spelled nowhere else.
3. Namespace rule, decided here: `customizationNamespace(baseNs)` returns `<base_ns>_custom`, never derived. **A base namespace longer than 13 characters gets no pair namespace**: the helper answers a named reason and N-13 refuses that base with a sentence. ⛔ No truncation, no hashing: either is a second spelling the declaration cannot be checked against. ADR-0146 is silent here, so the PR lists it for the maintainer. Nothing in the repository is affected today.
4. The `__c` reservation: a suffix constant and `isExtensionFieldName(name)`. Enforcement is N-23b.
5. A closed list of overridable types, checked against the registry: `permission`, `position`, `capability` excluded; `object` extend-only; `flow`'s and `action`'s D9 conditions carried as data. The PR classifies `seed`, `external_catalog`, `tool` and `skill`, or reports to the maintainer the ones D2 cannot decide.
6. The base-field display whitelist as one closed constant, each member admitted by D10's test against `FieldSchema`. The per-field patch slot goes on `ObjectExtensionSchema` here, or the PR says it rides N-23a.
7. Generated baselines (authorable surface, JSON Schema, reference docs) regenerated; the `Metadata-protocol` level declared.

**Tests.** The schema accepts and refuses `overrides` shapes. Table tests cover the helpers (dotted ids, 13- and 14-character namespaces, the range). A type-list test pinned to the registry fails when an unclassified runtime-creatable type is added. A whitelist test checks every member exists on `FieldSchema` and none is structural.

**Not here.** Any door: the write gate (N-09), the read (N-10), the ensure door (N-13), uninstall (N-14), enforcing `__c` and the whitelist (N-23a/b).

**Dedupe.** Searched `override declaration`, `__c suffix`, `custom namespace derived`, `display property whitelist`: only #28236 and #28237 match.

Links back: #28236, #28390 (ruling 6542177429), ADR-0146 D2, D3, D6, D10, ADR-0048 §3.2.
